name: sdd-evolution-harness-engineering
displayName: SDD Evolution — From `# write a function` to Harness Engineering
description: Hands-on, lego-style workshop on the one-year arc of agentic coding: from hashtag prompts through the four-stage RPIV pipeline (Research, Plan, Implement, Verify) into shared architecture, brownfield onboarding, wrapping upstream agents, the harness 2×2 (guides × sensors / computational × inferential), and parallel agents. Delivered as a self-contained static website.
author: jsburckhardt
prerequisites: A coding-agent CLI you are comfortable with (Claude Code, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, or similar)
git, gh, and a Python or Node toolchain installed
A GitHub account with `gh auth login` working
A modern web browser (the workshop is a static HTML site under site/)
objectives: Articulate what each RPIV stage produces and consumes without a cheat sheet
Promote a workitem decision into a shared ADR and have Research read it back automatically
Stand up RPIV on a brownfield repo by inferring implicit ADRs from existing code
Wrap an upstream coding agent without forking it by declaring artifact-path contracts
Distinguish guides (feedforward) from sensors (feedback), and computational from inferential mechanisms
Decompose a feature into parallel workitems that respect shared architecture and rendezvous points
